archetypes.name: schema-consistency
archetypes.rationale: The diff introduces multiple simultaneous schema changes (TSV 21→22 columns, new reviewer_signals[] array, new prune-decision.env canonical format) across producers and consumers in several scripts; any producer/consumer mismatch will silently corrupt analysis data.
archetypes.prompt_body: Audit whether every producer that emits the extended 22-column findings-classification.tsv (lib-findings-classification.sh, tally-plan-review.sh) and every consumer that reads it (fluff-analysis.py parse_design_tsv, test harnesses) agree on the column count, column order, and presence of the new body_severity column. Check that all round-meta.json producer paths that populate reviewer_signals[] include every required key (output_basename, slot_label, result_kind, ns_retry_reason, first_pass_trailing_content) and that all consumer paths (audit-scan-run.sh jq filters, test fixtures) reference those exact key names without typos. Verify the prune-decision.env canonical field list (ROUND, PRUNE_ACTIVE, PRUNE_STATUS, PANEL_FULL, ELIGIBLE, PRUNED_COUNT, PRUNED_COMBOS, PANEL_PRUNED_EMPTY) is written identically from write_prune_decision_env for both implement and design dispatch paths. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: signal-migration-correctness
archetypes.rationale: Three audit scans migrate from reading raw transcript files to reading reviewer_signals[] from round-meta.json; if any jq filter is semantically non-equivalent to the old file-based logic, scans will silently pass when they should fail.
archetypes.prompt_body: For each of the three migrated scans in audit-scan-run.sh (ns-retry-sidecars, codex-generalist-waste, trailing-content-no-issues-found), compare the new jq-based logic against the old file-based logic to verify they are semantically equivalent: does ns-retry-sidecars count the same entries, does codex-generalist-waste correctly match output_basename=="codex-generalist-output.txt", and does trailing-content-no-issues-found correctly sum first_pass_trailing_content==true across all rounds (not just round-1). Verify that the _audit_reviewer_signals_jq helper correctly aggregates across all round-*/round-meta.json files and that its unavailable return path (when no reviewer_signals array exists) triggers the skip result rather than silently producing a false pass. Check that the test fixture in test-audit-runs.sh for test 35 exercises all three migrated scan paths and that the ns-retry-sidecars fixture uses reviewer_signals and still produces count=1 with reasons=NO_ISSUES_FOUND_TOO_THIN. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
